steps.name: create-branch
steps.description: Create task/t0008_tts_eval_harness_baselines branch from main and plan the step list.

steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify t0006_kokoro_v5_stage2_subset is completed and its checkpoints/reference bundles are accessible.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create mandatory task folder structure including library asset subdirectory.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Review corpus for papers on GE2E speaker embeddings, resemblyzer, WER evaluation, and TTS latency benchmarking.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Search for current resemblyzer/GE2E usage patterns, ElevenLabs streaming API TTFB measurement, and Kokoro evaluation practices.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0002 voicepack extraction, t0003 build_pipeline.py, t0005/t0006 checkpoints and training logs to understand available artifacts.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Design the evaluation harness architecture, prompt-set loading, per-system synthesis adapters, scoring pipeline, and GPU budget for TTFB measurement on LLM-T1-NC80.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Provision LLM-T1-NC80 H100 VM for Kokoro TTFB/RTF measurement and install kokoro-finetune environment.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Build the evaluation harness library, copy ElevenLabs filler corpus from VM and DVC-track it, run all 7 systems plus floor control on val_96 and filler prompt sets, produce metrics.json and charts.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Destroy LLM-T1-NC80 after TTFB/RTF runs are complete and update costs.json.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Skipped — structured evaluation against fixed success criteria; no open-ended analysis needed at this stage.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md with all required tables and charts, metrics.json (variant format per system), and costs.json.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Skipped — no published speaker_sim/TTFB baselines for Kokoro-82M David voice fine-tuning exist in the corpus to compare against.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Generate follow-up task suggestions based on harness results and which systems pass/fail the success criteria.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators, capture session transcripts, update task.json status to completed.
